verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is a cloud platform that offers AI inference (Workers AI, AI Gateway), so a data-training privacy policy or opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a no-training commitment, a training opt-out, or any data-use policy for AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
